content:
Incident Bot: Declared INC-2025-11-12-STREAM. Reports of streaming responses ending early (missing [DONE]) from Support.
Hannah Schmitt: Escalation from Heliotrope. They say 'SSE disconnects' and partial answers in app. Request IDs in SUP-5321.
Ethan Park: Looking at traces now. Seeing 20-40s gap between deltas on tool path; client connection closed before next chunk.
Ava Chen: api-gw Envoy has downstream idle_timeout=30s for streaming route in us-east + us-west. If no bytes, it will close.
Dev Patel: Do we have any periodic flush/heartbeat? If runtime buffers until next token, that could be the gap.
Ethan Park: Runtime currently only writes on token deltas. Tool selection can be quiet for a while. We can add keep-alive bytes (comment frame) every 10s when stream open.
Mina Haddad: Please capture blast radius: regions, customer tiers. Also make sure status page wording avoids implying data loss; it's truncated outputs due to disconnect.
Ava Chen: Quick mitigation: increase idle_timeout to 120s on streaming route. Risk: ties up connections.
Ethan Park: Prefer heartbeat in runtime, but can raise timeout short-term.
Incident Bot: Mitigation step logged: increase us-east streaming idle_timeout to 120s (temporary).
Hannah Schmitt: Customer already seeing improvement after timeout change, but wants permanent fix.
Ethan Park: PR up: add keep-alive flush on stream when idle >10s. Will roll to us-east first, then us-west/eu-west.
Incident Bot: Resolved INC-2025-11-12-STREAM after keep-alive rollout and monitoring. Follow-ups: update known-issues page + backport to private installer.
